description: One step of a case of the conformance corpus (ConformanceCase.json): each is told apart by the member only it requires. conformance/sdk/README.md, "A case", says what each does.

oneOf.title: Let
oneOf.description: Name values for later steps.

additionalProperties.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

let.description: Each name, and the value it takes.

oneOf.title: Driver
oneOf.description: Ask the driver for an operation. It must succeed, with `returns` when given, or fail with `fails`. With `as`, the step does not wait: a later `settles` step does.

additionalProperties.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

returns.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

fails.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

as.description: The operation's name, for the `settles` or `abandon` step that ends it.

oneOf.title: Abandon
oneOf.description: Abandon an operation started with `as`, as its caller would.

oneOf.title: Settles
oneOf.description: An operation started with `as` settles: it succeeded, with `returns` when given; or failed with `fails`; or, `abandoned`, it ended because the case abandoned it and reported nothing.

returns.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

fails.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

abandoned.description: It ended because the case abandoned it.

oneOf.title: Wire
oneOf.description: The next request the client put on the wire is this operation, with each field given.

wire.description: The operation of the gateway's API, by its method and path.

at.description: When it is read: on arrival, once answered (the default), or once its stream has caught up.

status.description: The status it was answered with.

params.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The values its path carried.

body.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. Its body.

token.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The bearer token it carried.

additionalProperties.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

headers.description: The request's headers named here, each as a pattern; headers not named are not compared.

answer.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The body it was answered with.

as.description: The request's name, for a later step.

follows.description: A request named earlier, which was answered before this one arrived.

waited.description: A request named earlier, answered with a Retry-After, which this one waited out.

oneOf.title: Carried
oneOf.description: The stream a wire step named has carried this frame to the client.

is.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Closed
oneOf.description: The request a `wire` step named has ended with no answer reaching the client: the client closed it, or the proxy kept the gateway's answer from it (`answer-lost`).

oneOf.title: Progress
oneOf.description: An upload started with `as`, and not yet settled, has reported all of it sent: every report states the same total, none states less than the one before, and the last states the total.

oneOf.title: State
oneOf.description: The transport comes to report this state.

oneOf.title: Stays
oneOf.description: The transport is in this state and has reported no other since the case last read its state.

oneOf.title: Frame
oneOf.description: The next frame the client delivers on this channel is this one.

is.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Frames
oneOf.description: The client delivers this many more frames on this channel. What they are is held, as every frame is, to what the gateway sent.

oneOf.title: Error
oneOf.description: The next failure on the client's error stream is this one.

error.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Backend
oneOf.description: The backend does something (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Backend directives").

additionalProperties.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Quiet
oneOf.description: The client puts nothing more on the wire for this many milliseconds.

oneOf.title: Observe
oneOf.description: Live: an observer, named by `as`, begins observing a live query.

query.description: The live query, by its name in specs/src/client/refresh.json.

resource.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The resource a query kept per resource or per annotation is of.

annotation.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The annotation a query kept per annotation is of.

search.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. What `matchedResources` searches for.

filters.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature. The filters of a query kept per set of filters.

oneOf.title: Leave
oneOf.description: Live: the observer stops observing.

oneOf.title: Reaches
oneOf.description: Live: the observer comes to hold this state.

state.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Holds
oneOf.description: Live: the state the observer holds now is this one.

state.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Completes
oneOf.description: Live: the observer's live query completes.
Live: the next request the client makes of a service is this request on the bus.
Live: the next request the client makes of a service is this read over HTTP.

oneOf.title: Fetches
oneOf.description: Live: the next requests the client makes of a service are these, in whatever order it makes them.

oneOf.title: Scopes
oneOf.description: Live: the client's stream comes to name exactly these scopes.

items.$comment: An argument's value, or a pattern that resolves to one (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Claimed
oneOf.description: A worker case: the next job the worker reports as claimed, as it read the record.

claimed.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Refused
oneOf.description: A worker case: the next refusal of a claim the worker reports.

refused.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Signalled
oneOf.description: A worker case: the next held job whose cancellation the worker says was signalled.

signalled.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.

oneOf.title: Stalled
oneOf.description: A worker case: the next held job the worker says has stalled.

stalled.$comment: A value the case expects, as a pattern (conformance/sdk/README.md, "Values"): JSON by nature.
